notes:
Inbound SMB lead building a doc-search / RAG product for SMB legal and professional services customers. Primary ask: embeddings + reranking workflow, vector DB integration (Pinecone first; possible Milvus later), and clear cost model for hosted embeddings.

User quotes: "We want the simplest path to production without managing infra - hosted embeddings and a predictable per-doc cost is ideal." - CTO (Ethan Park).

Technical details / requirements (shorthand):
- Workload: ingestion of client docs (PDFs, DOCX) -> embeddings -> vector DB (Pinecone) -> rerank + LLM for answer generation.
- Scale target: 100k documents first 6 months, ~1M docs 12mo roadmap.
- Embedding throughput target: need to embed 10k docs/day during onboarding; eventual batch backfill 200k docs.
- Latency target for query-response: 300-500ms tail for embeddings+rerank acceptable; prefer <200ms for user-facing search if possible.
- Cost sensitivity: high - startup budget; wants per-doc cost estimate and guidance to lower costs (dimensionality, batching, caching).
- Model preference: open to small/medium open embeddings models (text-embedding-3-small equivalents) and to Redwood curated models if cost-effective.
- Reranking: interested in hybrid approach - vector nearest neighbor + lightweight neural reranker for top-k (k=10). Asking: does Redwood support single-call rerank or should we pipeline on client side?
- Integration questions: recommended pattern for Pinecone + Redwood hosted API; recommended batching size; rate limits and concurrency limits; webhook for ingestion completion; error handling for partial failures.

Security/compliance:
- SMB customers expect SSO for admin console; ask: SSO/SAML for team? (they have Okta)
- Need audit logs and basic retention controls.
- Data residency: default US; no immediate EU customers but may need EU in future.

Assets shared:
- Drive: pricing deck (drive:/decks/docglider-redwood-pricing-2026-02.pdf)
- Gmail thread with logs/examples (thread-1700023)
- Jira ticket RWD-3421 opened by AE for SE backlog (embedding throughput question)

Sales notes / tone: enthusiastic but cautious on cost. Good fit for hosted_api self-serve path; likely to convert to paid after successful batch backfill and clear cost metrics. Recommend set up SE deep-dive and provide sample cost model for 100k docs and 1M docs.
